author: Kyle Jackson
title: Oak Point Wealth Management Buys New Position in Apple (AAPL)
text:
Tweet 
Oak Point Wealth Management bought a new stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in the 4th quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The fund bought 966 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock, valued at approximately $163,000. 
A number of other institutional investors have also added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Blue Sky Asset Management LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the second quarter worth about $108,000. FNY Managed Accounts LLC increased its stake in Apple by 852.4% during the second quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $115,000 after acquiring an additional 716 shares during the last quarter. Private Vista LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the second quarter worth about $122,000. Crow Point Partners LLC increased its stake in Apple by 100.0% during the third quarter. Crow Point Partners LLC now owns 1,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $153,000 after acquiring an additional 500 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Reaves W H & Co. Inc. acquired a new stake in Apple during the second quarter worth about $200,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 61.33% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . 0.06% of the stock is owned by company insiders. Shares of AAPL stock opened at $175.24 on Wednesday. Apple has a 1 year low of $138.62 and a 1 year high of $183.50. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. The firm has a market capitalization of $889,474.50, a P/E ratio of 18.01, a PEG ratio of 1.32 and a beta of 1.19. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same period last year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. The firm’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. research analysts predict that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
AAPL has been the subject of several research analyst reports. BMO Capital Markets restated a “buy” rating and set a $199.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, December 20th. Citigroup restated a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, December 13th. KeyCorp restated a “buy” rating and set a $192.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, December 7th. UBS set a $190.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, December 4th. Finally, Vetr upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $177.17 price target for the company in a research note on Wednesday, November 29th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.53. Apple Profile

The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
